2607.24999.title: CogArena: A Multimethod Evaluation of Cognitive Ability Structure in Large Language Models
2607.24999.paper_summary: LLM cognitive scores are increasingly summarized as per-ability profiles whose dimensions should converge across tasks, respond selectively to matched interventions, and generalize beyond the models used to define them. We introduce CogArena, a procedurally generated 13-paradigm benchmark built around a multimethod framework for determining when cognitive-task scores warrant dimensional labels across five theory-motivated groupings. Across 55 open-weight models, nearly all paradigm correlations are positive and a common axis explains about half the variance. The within-grouping advantage is small, scoring-sensitive, and uncertain across model families. In a separately frozen, fully crossed study across 12 models from six families, targeted scaffolds show a small matched-grouping advantage, but no scaffold-specific contrast survives multiplicity correction and selectivity does not improve held-out-family prediction. The frozen confirmation criterion fails. A post-hoc alternate-wording replication produces a smaller positive estimate and again fails. Together, these results support a boundary conclusion. Theory-aligned prompting produces a small in-battery diagonal tendency, but the present evidence does not establish stable five-dimensional profiles. CogArena provides a workflow joining behavioral signatures, covariance, matched interventions, and out-of-family prediction before cognitive labels are attached to model scores.
2607.24999.paper_summary_zh: LLM 認知分數越來越多地被總結為每項能力的輪廓，其維度應該在任務之間收斂，對匹配的干預措施做出選擇性反應，並且能夠超越用來定義它們的模型進行概括。<lb/>我們介紹 CogArena，一個基於多方法框架的程序生成的 13 範式基準，旨在確定何時認知任務分數值得在五個理論驅動的分組中賦予維度標籤。<lb/>在 55 個開放權重模型中，幾乎所有範式的相關性都是正向的，並且一個共同軸解釋了約一半的變異性。<lb/>組內優勢較小，對分數敏感，並且在模型家族之間存在不確定性。<lb/>在一項獨立的凍結、完全交叉的研究中，涵蓋了來自六個家族的 12 個模型，針對性的支架顯示出小的匹配分組優勢，但沒有支架特定的對比在多重性修正後存活，且選擇性並未改善保留家族的預測。<lb/>凍結確認標準失敗。<lb/>事後的替代措辭重複產生了較小的正估計，再次失敗。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果支持邊界結論。<lb/>與理論對齊的提示產生了小的內部對角傾向，但目前的證據並未建立穩定的五維輪廓。<lb/>CogArena 提供了一個工作流程，將行為特徵、協方差、匹配干預和超出家族的預測結合在一起，然後再將認知標籤附加到模型分數上。
